concept: Comic frame + light reveals thoughts + swap arrows change punchline. Campus canteen and current Professor/Kassi character identities.

cover.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished landscape 16:9 key art COVER for the actual 2D comic puzzle game LIGHTBULB MOMENT, intended for a game page. Image references: 1 Professor exact character identity; 2 Kassi exact character identity; 3 existing painted campus canteen environment and storybook medium. Preserve the characters' big round heads, short puppet bodies, Indian brown skin colours, wardrobe and dark-plum thick outlines. Composition: upper/left 45 percent dominated by an exceptionally readable original illustrated title lockup, exact text LIGHTBULB on first line, MOMENT on second. Bold playful hand-lettered comic display lettering, creamy ivory with golden accents, dark-plum outline, subtle offset red print shadow; not a generic typeset font. Small original emblem above/alongside title: a golden lightbulb with a thought-bubble tail and two opposing curved arrows as filament, symbolising exchanging thoughts. On right and lower half, one large slightly tilted comic panel containing a dim IIIT-H canteen at night, windows midnight navy and teal, just enough painted architecture and stainless serving counter to establish campus. One floating bulb near upper middle casts an obvious broad warm gold light pool onto Professor and Kassi, fully illuminating BOTH characters and BOTH thought bubbles. Professor on right is sleepy and half-lidded yawning; Kassi left within panel is hungry, tongue licking lip, eagerly eyeing a small steel biryani plate on foreground table. Clearly show a round thought cloud above each: one crescent moon + small Z pictogram above Professor and one food bowl pictogram above Kassi. Between these clouds, a clean paired curved arrow gesture, ivory/gold with red accent, indicates swapping them; exactly TWO clouds, no duplicated thoughts. One restrained red editorial curl lightly bends the panel corner to communicate a changed punchline. Keep outer unlit room deep navy and silhouettes, no visible thoughts outside light, no combat weapons, no magic attacks or unrelated adventure. This is clever comic cause-and-effect comedy, a mischievous stage puzzle, not horror. Strong focal hierarchy TITLE -> BULB -> exchanging thoughts -> cast. Warm/cool contrast, clean shapes, confident cohesive storytelling, detailed painted room but simple flat/cel cast matching provided drawings. Leave comfortable outer margins; title never obscures faces or bubbles. No UI, buttons, developer branding, watermarks, fake award badges, extra words or subtitles. The ONLY readable text is LIGHTBULB MOMENT. One finished cover, wide 16:9 canvas.

logo.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create the standalone transparent title LOGO from the supplied game cover, matching its lettering, colour and emblem closely. Exact text LIGHTBULB on line 1, MOMENT on line 2. Copy the distinctive playful chunky hand-drawn cream-to-gold comic lettering, deep dark-plum thick contour and red offset rim visible in the cover; preserve legibility, same spelling and letter personalities. Compact centred stacked lockup, no excessive tilt, comfortable padding. Above the lettering place the SAME small emblem: an ivory comic thought cloud with a little thought tail, containing a golden lightbulb with two opposite curved swap arrows inside the bulb as its filament; short gold rays, strong dark-plum outline. This specific bulb/thought/swap combination is the game's Comic+Light+Twist identity. Emblem and lettering only, no scene, characters, extra thought clouds, food, captions, mockup, drop shadow extending across empty space, watermark or additional text. Produce genuine transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard or white canvas. Preserve the clean cartoon line quality. Landscape canvas with tight balanced lockup and at least 6 percent clear transparent margin.

scope: Asset delivery only; no runtime/menu/export changes.
validation: Visual inspection of spelling, thought swap, references and composition; PNG decode/dimensions; logo sampled corner alpha=0.
